name: Catherine the Great
summary: Dynamic and detail-oriented Security Engineer with over 7 years of experience in network security, risk assessment, and incident response. Committed to enhancing system security and protecting organizational assets through innovative solutions.

description: Developed and implemented security policies to protect sensitive data against threats.
Conducted regular vulnerability assessments and penetration tests.
Collaborated with IT departments to respond to security incidents swiftly.
Educated staff on security best practices and compliance regulations.
Monitored security systems and responded to security alarms and incidents.
Executed risk assessments and developed actionable mitigation plans.
Performed malware analysis and threat intelligence reporting.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Led a project to enhance internal security protocols, resulting in a 30% decrease in potential security incidents.
Developed a custom monitoring system to detect and respond to network intrusions in real time.
